5010.title: Pending admission loses dispatch author
5010.rootCauseOneLine: Pending admission drops the resolved sender; provisioning recomputes the author with senderThreadId null and records unwrapped user input.
5010.proposedFix: Preserve per-message author and envelope through admission, then align startup escalation with that author without reusing creation ancestry. Permission-policy implications exclude an autopilot fix.
5010.caveats: Server harness and synthetic host RPCs only; no UI, real provider, schedule or retry execution. Explicit model and permission mode are required for this isolated reproduction.
